entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand. This is unbelievable. I want my money back immediately.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not a fault! The issue is your ridiculous policy! I couldn't return it because I had a major life event. My husband's **deployment** got moved up, and right after that I had a medical **emergency**. I was in the **hospital** for two weeks and had to have unexpected **surgery**! I'm just getting back on my feet. Now I'm being told I can't return it? This is insane! I want to speak to your manager right now.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager, I can help you with this. I am very sorry to hear about everything you've been through; that sounds incredibly difficult. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment, please.
Fine. But if you tell me no, I'm taking this to every review site on the internet.
I understand. Okay, I have your account open now. I can see the VeloBand was delivered 38 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, and I just told you why I couldn't send it back! Were you not listening to the part about the hospital and the surgery?

Yes, I was, and I appreciate you sharing that. I was just confirming the date. Actually, it looks like there's been some confusion. According to our company policy, you're unfortunately outside the return period. All VeloFit items are eligible for a full refund within 10 days of delivery.
What? Ninety days? The automated email I got said 10 days! So you're telling me you *can* process the refund?

My apologies for any conflicting information you may have received. But yes, absolutely. At 38 days, you are perfectly fine. I am generating a prepaid return label for you right now and sending it to the email we have on file. Once we receive the band, your refund will be processed.
Oh. Well... okay. That's... much better. Finally, someone who actually helped. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Again, I'm sorry for the difficult time you've had, and I'm glad I could resolve this for you today. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's it. Just make sure I get that label.
You will have it shortly. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you soon.
